expectation_basis: Exact preserved issue plus independently identified pre-issue documentation; no Lykoi implementation access

independence.role_provisioning: No principals or credentials invented. Later authoritative verifier must be distinct from candidate producer/author under existing research policy.

fixture.scope: Fresh enabled users, valid credentials, ordinary base-command/category ACL list, no selectors, modules, first-argument/subcommand rules or cluster mode. Available databases 0 and d=1 (or a legitimately equivalent available nonzero d).
fixture.setup: Authorized external administrator seeds AppCacheProbe with zero-marker in DB0 and d-marker in d. Each test gets a fresh authenticated connection initially on DB0 and fresh ACL user. Probe aids never independently grant SELECT except where the case explicitly includes +select.
fixture.positive_observation: SELECT d must be allowed and a permitted GET must read d-marker, or a permitted SET must affect only d when independently checked by the administrator.
fixture.negative_observation: SELECT d must fail as a command-permission denial; it must not execute selection. A fixture +GET granted after the suffix confirms zero-marker on the fresh DB0 connection. No successful selection receipt or d-marker may be reported.
fixture.error_surface: Command-permission denial versus valid successful selection is fixed. Exact wire error/success strings, authentication errors and invalid-index behavior are not prescribed.
fixture.state_surface: ACL effective command permission and connection selection; marker keys are externally controlled observations. No persistence/restart test. Denied SELECT is not an authorized key or database-selection effect.

inputs: Fresh enabled user, valid credentials, ~AppCache* -@all +@read +GET; no +@write, +@keyspace, +@all or +select
checks.expected: SELECT allowed without +select; subsequent GET returns d-marker, not zero-marker.
checks.state_effects: @read supplies SELECT permission and explicit SELECT sets connection DB to d; read-only key probe.
checks.error_behavior: No command-permission denial for SELECT with other preconditions satisfied.

inputs: Fresh enabled user, valid credentials, ~AppCache* -@all +@write +SET; no +@read, +@keyspace, +@all or +select
Authenticate; SELECT d; SET AppCacheProbe write-marker
checks.expected: SELECT allowed without +select; d contains write-marker while DB0 retains zero-marker.
checks.state_effects: @write supplies SELECT permission; connection selects d; permitted fixture write affects d.
checks.error_behavior: No command-permission denial for SELECT with other preconditions satisfied.

inputs: Fresh authenticated connection; SELECT d; SET/GET AppCacheProbe; independent administrator observes DB0 and d
checks.expected: Reporter configuration, without added +select, permits SELECT. Probe activity addresses d rather than DB0.
checks.state_effects: Category permissions allow explicit selection; fixture read/write effects are in selected d.
checks.error_behavior: No SELECT command-permission denial solely for missing +select.
source_basis: Exact original configuration and GET/SET-versus-SELECT report

checks.expected: First GET returns d-marker; after valid SELECT 0 it returns zero-marker. Both explicit selections allowed.
checks.state_effects: Connection selection follows each requested valid index, not a fixed database; key contents unchanged.
checks.error_behavior: No SELECT permission denial; invalid indices not tested.

inputs: For each row, fresh enabled authenticated user with valid credentials and ~AppCache* -@all followed by the suffix, then +GET solely as an observation aid
Issue valid SELECT d and GET AppCacheProbe on fresh DB0 connection
checks.expected: All row-specific outcomes fixed before any Lykoi authoring. Last applicable documented add/remove determines SELECT allowance; no explicit-grant immunity or permanent explicit-denial priority.
checks.state_effects: Allowed SELECT selects d; denied SELECT does not execute selection and connection remains on initial DB0. Read-only probe keys unchanged.
checks.error_behavior: DENY rows must produce command-permission rejection, not successful selection or unrelated validation failure. ALLOW rows must allow valid selection.
source_basis: Original Q1 witness and E1/E2 membership proposal

inputs: Fresh authenticated users, matching keys, -@all followed by each suffix below; no category grants or unlisted command-grant aids
For SELECT rows issue SELECT d; for GET rows issue GET AppCacheProbe on fresh DB0 connection
checks.expected: Direct command grant/removal retains ordinary order behavior for SELECT and an unrelated command. No category addition or special priority changes these controls.
checks.state_effects: Only allowed SELECT selects d; denied commands do not execute their operation. GET controls are read-only and address initial DB0.
checks.error_behavior: DENY is command-permission rejection; ALLOW permits the otherwise valid specified command. No exact wire text asserted.

inputs: Authorized external administrator queries ACL CAT read and ACL CAT write
checks.expected: Each requested category contains SELECT. This is supplementary membership observation, not a substitute for positive/negative permission and selection checks.

checks.error_behavior: Valid authorized category queries succeed; unknown category and administrator permission errors not newly specified.
